notes: the Imam speaks inside Yasir's story («قَالَ لَهُ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ يَا زَيْدُ»): he is the last link after the narrator (owner ruling 5); the bare kunya is written as it stands (owner ruling 3)
the second «قَالَ يَاسِرٌ» is the same narrator inside his own story; زيد بن موسى is in the scene only
